header: Example reviews of paid plans and services
total_reviews: Examples from Pro, Agency and Creator Care

reviews.author: Daniel R., agency lead (example)
reviews.title: Live in four days with the Launch bundle
reviews.review_text: We booked the €1,790 Launch bundle: Pro licence, installation and the editor workshop. We went live in four days, and our editors built pages on their own by Friday.

reviews.author: Priya N., product owner (example)
reviews.title: Pro support answers by the next morning
reviews.review_text: The 2-day response usually means the next morning. Each LTS compatibility update arrived before we had planned for it, and our designers use the early-access presets.

reviews.author: Marcus L., CTO (example)
reviews.title: Brand adaptation done properly
reviews.review_text: We ordered a custom theme preset and got our brand as colour tokens, with dark mode and checked contrast. Four stars only because we should have ordered it at the start.

reviews.author: Sofia B., site owner (example)
reviews.title: Creator Care keeps our upgrades on schedule
reviews.review_text: We get four dev hours a month for €490 from the people who built Desiderio. That covers priority fixes and security monitoring, and our next LTS upgrade was planned months ahead.
